event: Gary Lineker health and ageing confession

articles.title: Gary Lineker admits 'we're all worried' as he opens up on death fears
articles.content: Gary's reportedly in excellent shape, doing pilates and seeing a personal trainer three times a week, but that doesn't mean he hasn't started to feel the impact of turning 65

articles.title: Gary Lineker, 65, admits health fears and says 'I'm not worried about death'
articles.content: Gary Lineker has openly confessed he's "not worried about death", but admits he's troubled by the prospect of cognitive deterioration in his later years. Gary's broadcasting career following his football days has proved remarkably successful, becoming the face of Walkers crisps through their advertisements since the 1990s and enjoying a quarter-century stint with the BBC . He also presented Match of the Day until his tenure at the broadcaster concluded last year. The programme has since been helmed by Kelly Cates, Mark Chapman and Gabby Logan, though Gary has remained busy with various projects. He co-owns podcast powerhouse Goalhanger, which produces the acclaimed "The Rest Is" franchise, including The Rest Is Football - presented by Gary alongside former footballers Alan Shearer and Micah Richards . Gary has also turned his attention to American audiences after launching a Netflix adaptation of the podcast for the World Cup ; this has subsequently expanded to encompass Premier League coverage as well. He's said to be in superb physical condition, practising Pilates and working with a personal trainer three times weekly, though this hasn't prevented him from noticing the effects of reaching 65. Gary revealed to The Observer Magazine: "I've definitely noticed ageing since I turned 65. Knees a bit creakier, hips a bit creakier. I always thought if I could get to maybe 80, living in a relatively healthy, fit state - not lose my marbles - and then just go overnight, I'd take that. "I'm not worried about death. It's the suffering along the way. Particularly for footballers, we're all worried about the possible onset of dementia or Alzheimer's. But just get me to Switzerland if it gets that bad. I've got no interest in growing old like that." Gary also presents a new ITV programme called The Box. In this show, 10 celebrities are crammed into yellow boxes and transported to various locations across the country, where they face a series of "tricky" challenges upon the doors opening. Previously discussing the show, Gary said: "It's different - it's something I've never done before, which appealed to me, alongside the unique nature of the concept. It's fun, it's family-friendly, and it's great prime time telly. What's not to like? !". "You make assumptions about how someone will cope based on what you know of them, and then The Box opens and you're proved completely wrong." In the inaugural series, Gary will supervise an impressive line-up of personalities: Danny Aarons, Ellie Taylor, Graeme Souness, JB Gill, Jenny Ryan, Joey Essex, John Bercow, Ranvir Singh, Sara Davies and Shakira Khan. Gary confesses he struggled to keep a straight face during filming , admitting he "didn't always manage it". He also hinted at some of the highlights viewers can anticipate, singling out two celebrities in particular: Danny Aarons and John Bercow. He added: "You'll see I didn't always manage it. Without wanting to give too much away, one of the earliest days of filming saw Danny sprint off at a well-known racecourse, not entirely sure what he was doing or why. "Even thinking back to that now, and having seen it a few times since, it's very funny. John Bercow at Butlins was also tremendous."

event: Darren Fletcher confrontation with abusive autograph hunter

articles.title: Darren Fletcher seen confronting abusive Man United fan immediately after Champions League win
articles.content: Darren Fletcher was applauded by Man United fans for putting an abusive supporter in their place on Thursday night. The Red Devils returned to the Champions League with a 4-0 win over Azerbaijani minnows Sabah . Fletcher is a hugely popular figure at United from his playing days and his time as interim manager Getty Goals from Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes , Benjamin Sesko and Lisandro Martinez saw Michael Carrick ‘s side cruise to a comfortable victory. However, there were some unsavoury scenes after the match as players made their way home from Old Trafford. Fletcher, who is currently head coach of United’s Under-18s, was seen verbally confronting a supporter near the first-team coach. “Listen, it doesn’t matter, you can’t speak like that,” an angry Fletcher said. View Tweet: https://x.com/hashtag/mufc?src=hash&ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw “Show some respect. You’re the reason people don’t sign.” It appears the argument began after Man United players decided not to stop and sign autographs. While the fan continued to protest, it was not clear exactly what was said to spark the row. Other supporters in the video cheered ex-United midfielder Fletcher for backing the players and chanted his name. Manchester City next On the pitch, Carrick watched Sesko score for the second consecutive game after his return from injury. However, the United boss did not reveal whether the Slovenian striker would get his first Premier League start when the Red Devils host Manchester City in the derby on Sunday. The return of Sesko has been a huge boost for Carrick Getty Cunha has started up front in the top-flight so far this season, with Marcus Rashford and Patrick Dorgu utilised on the left side of attack. “It’s not an easy decision, of course it’s not,” Carrick said. “But it’s definitely one I’d prefer: to have goals in the team and for the boys to be playing well. “The understanding they all have is that sometimes it’s going to be a start, sometimes it’s going to be finishing the game. “We need that within the group, from game to game over the season, to be able to call upon slightly different kind of things at different times. “It’s fantastic they’re all in good form and started so well.”

event: Pochettino demands reassignment of Chelsea 2017 title

articles.title: Mauricio Pochettino demands Premier League strip club of title in extraordinary interview
articles.content: Mauricio Pochettino has called for his former club Chelsea to be stripped of a Premier League title in a new bombshell interview. Pochettino had one season in charge at Chelsea in the 2023/24 season, before he left via a mutual agreement following a sixth-placed finish. But his best work in England came with Spurs , who he led to consecutive second-placed finishes in the 2015/16 and 2016/17 campaigns. Spurs recorded 86 points but lost out to Antonio Conte Chelsea's, who recovered from a shaky start to win the title by seven points. Mauricio Pochettino calls out Chelsea rule breaches in extraordinary interview However, nearly a decade on and Pochettino has claimed he should be a Premier League champion as he spoke out about Chelsea being punished. In March, Chelsea, having been charged by the Premier League for breaches of competition rules, were hit with a £10.75 million fine. The fine would have been £20 million but was reduced by 50% because Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital self-reported 74 breaches of Football Association rules when they bought Chelsea in 2022. A six points deduction was not applied upon appeal after Chelsea admitted to making £47 million in secret payments to unregistered agents and third-parties regarding transfers between 2011 and 2018. Transfers involving Eden Hazard, Samuel Eto'o, Willian, Ramires, David Luiz, Andre Schurrle and Nemanja Matic were in the Premier League's report and all four of those aforementioned players played in Chelsea's title triumph. None of the players are implicated or accused of any wrongdoing. Speaking to UK media outlets, including the BBC , Pochettino said: "We should win one title, one Premier League. We should have been awarded it. "They were punished, they admitted, so that's it? The title should be for the team that was second. "It's true that we didn't compete with the same rules. OK, now we can say that they scored goals, they won games, and like this. OK, that's it, but it's completely fair to say that we didn't compete before the start of the season with the same card. "Maybe with the same rules, if we apply the same things, maybe we could've signed some players that would have made the team better or scored more goals. It's not me complaining. It's the truth. If they admitted they broke the rules, the Premier League title was for the second best team. "I'm not scared to say the truth. The Chelsea fans will be upset with me because I'm saying this, but if we were at Tottenham and broke the rules I'd admit the same." How else were Chelsea punished for rule breaches? On top of the reduced fine, Chelsea received two transfer bans. A one-year ban was suspended for two years, while there also a nine-month suspension on signing academy players imposed. This punishment, which also carried a £750,000 fine, was in relation to the registration of academy players between 2019 and 2022. The Premier League acknowledged Chelsea's "exceptional cooperation" and "pro-active self-reporting". Pochettino is currently managing of the United States national team and took charge at the World Cup on home soil in the summer.

Staveley, a former co-owner of Newcastle, had agreed a deal to purchase West Ham joint-chair...

articles.title: Amanda Staveley breaks silence on West Ham saga and insists this isn’t over yet
articles.content: Amanda Staveley has expressed her ‘disappointment’ at PCP Capital Partners’ failed attempt to invest in West Ham United. The British business executive, alongside husband Mehrdad Ghodoussi, was keen on a return to football having spearheaded the Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund takeover of Newcastle United in October 2021. Amanda Staveley and Mehrdad Ghodoussi saw their efforts to invest in West Ham foiled Getty West Ham have seen substantial change in recent years with Daniel Kretinsky playing a more influential role in the boardroom since his investment in 2021. In a statement released on Friday, Staveley revealed that PCP’s original offer ‘was for both David Sullivan’s 38.8 per cent stake and Vanessa Gold’s 25 per cent stake’ in the Championship club. But the pre-emption process that provided Kretinsky the opportunity to match PCP’s offer has now been accepted . Therefore, Kretinsky and Sullivan will retain majority control of West Ham. And while Staveley, who co-owned Newcastle between 2021 and 2024, openly revealed her disappointment at the outcome, her ambitions for the club remain open. What did Amanda Staveley say about PCP’s failed takeover of West Ham? “We are obviously disappointed not to have been successful in our bid to acquire the 25% shareholding in West Ham United ,” Staveley said in a statement. “For transparency our original offer was for both David Sullivan ‘s 38.8% stake and Vanessa Gold’s 25.1% stake in the club. “There was always the potential that the other shareholders would take up their rights under the shareholders agreement which is what they have elected to do. “From the outset we and our global investment partners approached this opportunity with enormous respect for West Ham, its history, identity and most importantly loyal and committed supporters. “We saw real potential to make a positive difference, rejuvenate the club and help West Ham compete consistently at the highest level of English football. Czech businesman Daniel Kretinsky is set to become the majority owner at West Ham Getty Kretinsky and David Sullivan will retain majority control of the Championship club Getty “Mehrdad and I along with our partners retain the greatest respect for the West Ham community who supported us both in the stands and online in recent weeks. “We will continue to follow this process closely. Our ambitions for the club remain and we would be open to the opportunity to work constructively with the existing shareholders in the future subject to use not taking up other opportunities that have been present to our consortium in the week of events over the past week.” The outcome may come as a huge disappointment to sections of the club’s fanbase who have grown disillusioned with the ongoing ownership saga. There were also promises of significant investment in the squad this summer that failed to materialise. But the much-needed conclusion to the tale has been welcomed by the Hammers’ Fan Advisory Board who hope the decision will create stability at the club. “The West Ham United Fan Advisory Board welcomes the announcement confirming the significant change in the Club’s shareholding and Daniel Kretinsky becoming West Ham United’s largest individual shareholder,” its statement read. West Ham’s Fan Advisory Board have called for stability at the club Getty “After a prolonged period of uncertainty, we hope this represents an important moment of stability and the beginning of a new chapter for our Club. “We particularly welcome Daniel Křetínský’s acknowledgement of the responsibility that comes with his position and his commitment to communicate further with supporters once the transactions are complete. “Change of control must now mean change of direction. We also look forward to clarity around the role David Sullivan may or may not play outside of being a shareholder. “He resigned from the board and we would hope that position remains the same going forward. “West Ham United supporters have demonstrated extraordinary loyalty to this Club, including more than 50,000 committing to season tickets following relegation. They now deserve to hear a clear, ambitious and credible vision for the future. “That vision must explain how West Ham intends to return to the Premier League and establish itself there sustainably; the strategy for football, recruitment and the Academy; the future of the London Stadium and matchday experience; and how supporters will be genuinely placed at the heart of the Club. “The FAB has consistently called for West Ham United to be run as a modern, professional and ambitious football club, with experienced executives empowered to manage its day-to-day operations and clear strategic leadership from the Board. We now have an opportunity to continue to make that a reality. “The FAB welcomes this new chapter and wishes Daniel Křetínský and the Club’s leadership every success. “The uncertainty must now give way to stability. The change in ownership must be followed by clear leadership. And very soon, supporters must be shown the vision for the West Ham United we are all trying to build.”

event: Ismail Kartal resignation after Roma game

articles.title: Champions League manager immediately resigns minutes after opening match
articles.content: Fenerbahce manager Ismail Kartal announced that he has resigned moments after his side’s Champions League opener. Kartal, who was only appointed in June, confirmed he would be leaving in his post-match press conference. Kartal quit his job just minutes after the full time whistle in the Champions League Getty The Turkish giants had just drawn at home to Roma in their first match of the league phase when he revealed the news. “I am resigning from my position while there is still time,” he said. “I am resigning with the understanding that I will never return. “I have been here for three months. From the beginning of the season until today, the training sessions and camps I conducted with my players… our president and managers tried to help us in every way. Those were wonderful days. “As of this evening, I congratulate my players and I am resigning from my position. “Therefore, I would like to thank all my fans, media members, staff, and fellow players who have supported me until today. “I made this decision to pave the way for my club. We made this decision together as a team.” Kartal has now ended his fourth spell in charge of Fenerbahce, having taken charge in 2014, 2022, 2023 and earlier this year. During his fourth spell, he only led the club into 11 games, winning six of them, drawing three and losing two, with one of the wins coming against Lyon last month, which ended in a chaotic brawl . Fenerbahce’s two losses had both come in the Turkish Super Lig though, meaning they are sitting ninth after four games. And now, after failing to win in the Champions League , the 65-year-old has made the decision to depart. Kartal revealed that he and the team have decided that he will leave his post Getty Player stunned by Kartal resignation It appears Kartal didn’t run this by his players with Fenerbahce goalscorer Archie Brown discovering the news while giving interviews to journalists post-match. The English left-back cut a stunned figure when a Fenerbahce official revealed to him that Kartal had resigned, asking: “What do you mean he resigned?” After it was explained Kartal announced his resignation in a press conference, a confused Brown enquired: “As what? As coach?” Wondering if things had been lost in translation, Brown asked: “What do you mean, resigned? He’s not the coach any more?” Resigned to the news of Kartal resigning was true, a shell-shocked Brown finished by saying: “I didn’t know about this.” View Tweet: https://t.co/Iq8hZO7pDE Leaving with a point Kartal dropped the bombshell news straight after his side drew 1-1 with Serie A side Roma in Istanbul. Bryan Cristante scored the opener for the visitors in the 39th minute, with them taking their lead into half time. But Birmingham-born Brown equalised just after the break and neither side could then find a winner. Fenerbahce’s line-up included six-time Premier League winners with Manchester City Ederson and Nathan Ake, World Cup winner N’Golo Kante and ex- Manchester United winger Mason Greenwood. Romelu Lukaku was also introduced as a late substitute, but he was unable to find the winning goal for his side. Fenerbahce will now be looking to bring in a new boss ahead of their league game against Gaziantep on Sunday evening. Their next European outing sees them travel to Aston Villa on October 14. Fenerbahce host Liverpool later in the league phase on November 4.

event: Olise awkward DAZN interview after Bodo Glimt

articles.title: Michael Olise divides football fans with uncomfortable interview after Bayern Munich win in Champions League
articles.content: Michael Olise has left football fans with an awkward interview after bagging a brace in Bayern Munich's first Champions League game of the season. Vincent Kompany' s side trounced Bodo/Glimt 5-0 at the Allianz Arena, with all of the goals coming in the second half. Jamal Musiala broke the deadlock in the 47th minute, before Harry Kane and Alphonso Davies got in on the act. Olise added gloss on the win with a late double, which puts Bayern second in the overall league table after one game. Michael Olise goes viral for brief interview answers after Man of the Match display The Frenchman, one of the most in-form players in world football at the moment, was interviewed by DAZN following the win. But Olise, a man of few words, prompted reaction aplenty with the way in which he answered questions. The interviewer praised his shooting ability and asked how it felt to score two brilliant goals, to which the Man of the Match replied: "I don't know". READ NEXT: Michael Olise has played entire footballing career without signing contract that 'doesn't interest him' He was asked whether it is something he thinks about or just does, with Olise commenting, "I shoot and it goes in or doesn't go in". The presenter then made the point that if it is easy, everyone could do it as he said Olise was "the only one". Laughing awkwardly, he said: "I'm not the only one who can score goals. I don't think so". 🚨😅| Michael Olise asked how it feels to score such great goals: "I don't know". Asked how he does it: "I shoot and it goes in" pic.twitter.com/vw5b7ojCdI — Kalshi FC (@KalshiFC) September 10, 2026 The former Crystal Palace winger's demeanour and short responses led to the journalist telling Olise that he "makes it quite difficult to do an interview". The 24-year-old clearly prefers being on the pitch to being in interviews and naturally, his chat went viral. One fan did not enjoy Olise's interview, writing on X: "Cannot be real adults laughing at this. Just comes across awfully, grown man putting on this act is beyond cringe." A second said: "It's not funny and it shouldn't be normalised either. This kind of response is directly disrespectful to the journalist whose sole intention was to empathize with their interviewee. A third added: "Now this is awful this is not nonchalant matter." Another user had a different view, commenting: "I love this guy. He just wanna do his bob and go home." A final person agreed and said: "Straight to the point man I love it." Why Michael Olise rarely celebrates goals in an emotional manner explained Olise is a unique character known for being incredible nonchalant and laidback and it even extends to his goal celebrations as well as interviews. Often he will be muted even after curling one in the top corner. It dates back to his time playing for Reading, with Michael Morrison explaining it is not something he started doing when he got more popular. "We’d say he’s a bit weird sometimes because when he scored goals, he sometimes wouldn’t celebrate," he told The Athletic . "We’d be like, ‘Mike, you’ve just scored an important goal and you’re just walking back?’. What’s he doing? "Then he’d play two-touch with the manager in the gym, he’d win a point in that, and he’d be shouting and celebrating, but on a Saturday, he’d score a goal in front of the home end and just stand there. "We never really worked out why. He could never give us an answer but he’s just different; a special player." Olise was asked the question during an interview with Highsnobiety in June and explained that he just doesn't get the same feeling as other players when he finds the net. He said: "I am not a super emotional person. I don’t react the same way everyone else reacts."

articles.content: Ecco cosa è successo al termine della sfida tra Bayern Monaco e Bodo/Glimt: protagonista il talento della nazionale francese

articles.title: Reporter verzweifelt - Olise ist selbst im Interview … außergewöhnlich
articles.content: Nicht nur für Gegenspieler ist Bayerns Michael Olise ein Graus – auch manch Interviewer beißt sich an dem Exzentriker die Zähne aus. Frag nach beim DAZN-Reporter, der nach Bayerns 5:0-Sieg in der Champions League gegen Bodo/Glimt dem Franzosen etwas Gehaltvolles zu entlocken versuchte. Oja. Doch. Es passiert. Via Video-Studium nachvollziehbar, nach 24 Sekunden. Da ziehen sich Michael Olises Mundwinkel dezent in die Breite und deuten so etwas Ähnliches wie ein Lächeln an. Den Rest des – nach wenigen Stunden schon kultigen – 40-sekündigen Interviews steht er relativ apathisch da. Wirkt, als würde er auf die U-Bahn warten. Nicht, als hätte er gerade in der Königsklasse zwei Traumtore erzielt und mit Bayern Bodo Glimt in Grund und Boden gezangelt.„Bin nicht der Einzige“Michael Olise ist außergewöhnlich. Das stellt er auf dem Platz mit seinem genialen linken Fuß regelmäßig unter Beweis. Seine Extravaganz lässt sich auch im Bereich Mode nicht abstreiten. Und spätestens seit Donnerstagabend auch in Sachen Kommunikation nicht. Der DAZN-Reporter konnte einem fast schon leidtun. Und gab auch zu: „Sie machen mir das Interview nicht leicht.“ Tatsächlich mühte er sich eine knappe Minute lang emsig ab, Olise mehr als Ein-Wort-Antworten abzuluchsen; ihn zu seiner Genialität zu befragen; zu ergründen, wie er denn so sensationelle Tore schießen könne. Der Interviewer zerbröselte aber regelmäßig und beständig an Olises Verbal-Catenaccio. Zumindest einen ganzen Satz entlockte er seinem wortkargen Gesprächspartner dann doch. Einen wirklich Burner gab der aber auch nicht ab. „Ich bin nicht der Einzige, der Tore schießen kann“, sagte Olise. Und war dann wieder völlig stoisch und konnte (oder wollte) nicht erklären, was ihn eigentlich glücklich macht. „Tore schießen und gewinnen vielleicht?“, suggerierte der DAZN-Mann schon. „Ja“, antwortete Olise.Sehen Sie hier das jetzt schon sagenumwobene Interview selbst.Zwei SupertoreEin Glück für den FC Bayern, dass er auf dem Spielfeld deutlich konkreter zu Werke geht als bei Interviews. So auch wieder einmal am Donnerstagabend in der Champions League gegen Bodo Glimt. Zweimal traf er beim 5:0-Sieg, jeweils äußerst sehenswert.Zum 23. Mal in Folge schrieben die Bayern zum Auftakt der „Königsklasse“ damit voll an. So ernüchternd das für die Münchener anmuten mag: Länger in Erinnerung als der 5:0-Sieg wird vermutlich Olises Interview danach bleiben.
